<strong>Cada webhook tem uma fila, entre: Each webhook has a queue, delivered in order. A delivery that fails is retried, at growing intervals, up to 10 times in under a minute, and the ones after it wait.
<strong>Na 10ª falha seguida o webhook é: On the 10th failure in a row the webhook is turned off and the deliveries that were waiting are discarded. You turn it back on in Settings, with an empty queue.
<strong>Responda com qualquer 2xx em até: Reply with any 2xx within 3 seconds and do the heavy lifting afterwards. Any other reply, or none, counts as a failure.
<strong>Só chegam mensagens novas.</stro: Only new messages arrive. The history the phone sends after connecting doesn't become deliveries, and neither do poll votes.

Um nome curto para este número, como Pes: A short name for this number, like Personal or Work. Your AI tool sees this name when it uses WhatsApp, and it's included in every webhook delivery.

Um receptor mínimo em Python, sem biblio: A minimal receiver in Python, with no libraries: it checks the signature, replies right away and shows who wrote what. Run it, add the webhook with the address http://127.0.0.1:8080/whatsapp and paste the key where indicated.

The terms are yours: your company's name, a product's, your competitors', a big client's, or the words that tend to come before a problem.
